migration.notes: Restores historical workspace schema 2.1→2.2→2.3 migration edges, permits bounded migration-capable bootstrap for supported older workspaces, and makes canonical GitHub identity authoritative over stale alias/cache content.

notes: Legacy Workspace Compatibility release. Existing supported 2.1/2.2 workspaces migrate additively to 2.3 before normal domain loading; canonical account facts and account identity are preserved.

additive/idempotent guidance and recovery metadata migration
